end.summary:
Practised identifying equal parts in shapes and naming halves, thirds and quarters.
Nisha identified that fractional parts must be equal in size.
They answered 2 of 4 attempts without help.
They were unsure about finding one-third of nine drumsticks at the end; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised equal sharing with Nisha using shapes and everyday roti examples. Nisha clearly explained that thirds and quarters need equal-sized parts, and this method worked in several answers. They mixed up the number of groups with the number of objects in one-third during the final drumsticks example, and this was not corrected before the lesson ended. At home, ask Nisha to split small groups of objects into three equal groups and say what one-third represents.
